title: "Software"

My research and development work has resulted in various software packages, primarily focused on bioinformatics and data visualisation.

## iSEE Ecosystem

The iSEE (Interactive SummarizedExperiment Explorer) ecosystem provides a framework for interactive visualisation of genomics data.

I have collaboratively developed and maintain the core iSEE package along with several extension packages in the Bioconductor project.

::: {.software-grid}

::: {.software-card}
**iSEE**

Core framework for interactive visualisation of genomics data.

::: {.software-links-inline}

## Other Contributions

Software to which I have contributed code, documentation, or other improvements.

::: {.software-grid}

::: {.software-card .software-card-wide}
**Panpipes**

Multi-modal single cell analysis pipelines.

Comprehensive workflows for scRNA-seq, CITE-seq, scV(D)J-seq, scATAC-seq, and spatial transcriptomics

::: {.software-links-inline}
[{{< fa globe >}}](https://panpipes-pipelines.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) [{{< fa brands github >}}](https://github.com/DendrouLab/panpipes) [{{< fa file-text >}}](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-024-03322-7)
